{{Top|leg}}
'''Dagoyan incense''' was a type of [[Incense/Legends|incense]] used by members of the [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan Masters]] in their [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] rituals. It aided them in finding inner peace and enlightenment.<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
